exchange.player_dialogue: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts!
exchange.npc_dialogue: *laughs softly* Oh, that’s so cheesy, but it actually made me smile! I didn’t expect a joke so soon, but I’m glad you shared that. You’re already making the morning a bit brighter here by the pool.

options.text: I’m glad I could make you smile, because you’re even cuter when you laugh.
Careful, if I keep starting your morning like this, you’ll start expecting cheesy jokes from me.
What’s your ideal slow-morning vibe when you’re actually in a good mood like this?
I’m going to let you enjoy the pool for a bit, but I like this energy a lot.

exchange.player_dialogue: Well, if I can make you smile with cheesy jokes, imagine what else I might be able to do.
exchange.npc_dialogue: *bites her lip, looking amused* Oh, you do have my attention now. I’m curious — what other surprises are you hiding behind that smile?

options.text: If I told you all my surprises at once, I’d have to work harder to keep you guessing.
You’ll have to earn the next one, because I’m enjoying this look on your face too much.
Honestly, I’m more interesting when someone gets me a little, so ask me something proper.
I should probably let you have the last word while I’m still ahead.

exchange.player_dialogue: Why did the coffee file a police report? Because it got mugged!
exchange.npc_dialogue: *Bursts out laughing* That was actually good! I wasn’t expecting to laugh before my morning caffeine. You might just be the funniest person I've met so far.

options.text: Careful, I’m going to start expecting a standing ovation for my coffee-less comedy now.
I’m glad I made you laugh, though, because I do like it when you’re this smiley around me.
What is it about you that makes you the funniest person in the villa when you’re not even trying?
I’m gonna leave that one there before I accidentally get too cocky about my joke game.

exchange.player_dialogue: Well, glad I could espresso myself and brew up some laughs!
exchange.npc_dialogue: *Laughs, eyes twinkling* Okay, okay, that was a good one. You’re definitely not just another regular around here.

options.text: I’m just getting started, you know, you bring out the best in me.
Careful, Maya, keep hyping me up and I’ll start thinking I’m your favourite already.
What is it about me that makes me feel like I’m earning a proper Maya stamp of approval?
I’m gonna grab a drink and come back before I get too full of myself.

exchange.player_dialogue: So, what do you think about this whole villa experience so far? It's a bit wild, right?
exchange.npc_dialogue: *laughs* Wild is one word for it! It’s like living in a reality TV bubble with snacks and drama. But honestly, it’s kind of fun having this little chaos to stir up every day, don’t you think?

options.text: I do, as long as you promise not to make me the main storyline before I’ve finished my drink.
You definitely seem like the type who’d smile while setting off a bit of chaos, what’s your favorite thing to stir up here?
Honestly, you make the villa sound better already, I like a girl who can laugh at the madness and lean into it.
I’m gonna let you get back to your chaos and snacks, but this was a good one.

exchange.player_dialogue: Exactly! I was just waiting for someone to start a snack rebellion. Maybe I should be the ringleader.
exchange.npc_dialogue: *laughs* Oh, I can see it now—Operation Snack Snatch! Count me in if it means we get some extra chips and gossip. You might be onto something there!

options.text: I knew you’d be the perfect co-conspirator—what’s your snack of choice when the gossip gets juicy?
Careful, Maya, if we pull this off together people might start thinking we’re trouble in the best way.
Be honest, are you here for the chips or the tea, because I need to know what I’m working with.
I’m gonna let you keep that mission and save the chips for later, but this was fun.

exchange.player_dialogue: I just wanted to say, you have such an amazing personality. It really lights up the room.
exchange.npc_dialogue: *She smirks and leans on the counter* Oh, that’s sweet of you to say, but don’t get me wrong, I’m not here to brighten anyone’s day for free. Gotta keep some mystery, right?

options.text: Fair, I’m not asking for the full director’s cut, just enough to keep me guessing.
Mystery suits you, but I reckon there’s a proper person under the banter if I’m patient.
So what’s the price of a little Maya teaser, then, or are you saying I’ll have to earn it?
I’ll leave you to your mysterious villain era, then, and come back when you’re ready to be a bit kinder.

exchange.player_dialogue: Oh, so you're saying your mystery fee comes with an emotional surcharge? Noted!
exchange.npc_dialogue: *laughs and shakes her head* Exactly! Don’t say I didn’t warn you. But hey, if you can pay up, maybe I'll consider letting you in on a secret or two.

options.text: Alright, name your price, because I’m not letting you keep all the good gossip to yourself.
I’m listening, but only if this secret is worth the hype you’re giving it.
Okay, I’ll pay up with one honest answer first, what’s the secret actually about?
I should let you enjoy your mystery for now, but I’m coming back for that secret later.

exchange.player_dialogue: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything!
exchange.npc_dialogue: *chuckles softly* I see what you did there, but that one’s pretty classic. Gotta try harder if you want to catch me off guard.

options.text: Alright, so you like a challenge — what kind of line would actually catch you off guard?
Careful, I’m only warming up, and I’ve got a few better ones in the vault.
Fair, that one was a bit safe, but you did laugh, so I’m taking the small win.
I’m gonna leave you with that one and save the next move for later.

exchange.player_dialogue: I've been thinking—what's something about you that most people don't see at first?
exchange.npc_dialogue: That's a fair question. I guess people usually see me as just calm and steady, but beneath that, I'm actually pretty private about what really matters to me. Not everyone gets to see that side easily.

options.text: I get that, and I’m glad you told me — what kind of stuff actually matters most to you?
That makes sense, you do seem like the type who keeps the good bits reserved for the right people.
So you’re saying I’ve got to earn the real Liam access pass, yeah?
I hear you, and I don’t want to pry if you’re not there yet.

event_narration.prose: The air thickens on the terrace as the recoupling ceremony wraps up, hearts racing in new alignments yet unseen. Just as the dust seems to settle, the villa doors burst open to reveal Aisha, the bombshell who promises to stir the calm and shake the foundations of every current couple. The islanders’ eyes widen, tension crackling as the day’s drama kicks into high gear.

event_narration.prose: The morning sun casts long shadows across the terrace as the recoupling ceremony wraps up with hearts pounding and alliances shifting in silence. Tension tightens the air, but no names are called—until the crushing moment when Liam's exit is announced, his dreams dashed as he steps through the Villa doors for the last time. The remaining islanders stand in stunned silence, the weight of goodbye heavy in the bright morning light.
